offering_description.value: Gencor designs and manufactures asphalt plants, highway pavers, combustion equipment and heat transfer systems. It sells to asphalt producers, paving contractors and industrial plant operators and provides replacement parts and field service.

primary_products.value: asphalt mixing plants; highway asphalt pavers; industrial burners; thermal fluid heating systems; replacement parts

primary_services.value: field maintenance and repair; equipment operator training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Asphalt mix producers, road paving contractors and industrial plant operators

end_markets.value: asphalt mix production; road and highway construction; industrial process heating

revenue_model.value: product sales: Asphalt plants, paving machinery, combustion and heating equipment, and replacement parts; service fees: On-site equipment maintenance and repair

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds asphalt plants, pavers and heating equipment from metal and purchased components for producers, contractors and industrial operators; service provider: Maintains and repairs installed equipment for asphalt producers and paving contractors

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States and Canada, with sales in other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Asphalt plants, highway pavers, industrial combustion systems and thermal fluid heating systems

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Company sales teams serving asphalt producers and industrial plant operators; distributors / dealers: Independent construction equipment dealers supplying highway pavers to contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Asphalt plant air emissions under EPA and state rules, plus OSHA workplace safety standards
